Twilight Tracker · Reviewer tutorial

Handle the Approval gate

A walkthrough for the person checking calibration tonight. Same clicks you will make in Twilight, Lakitu, and Ring.

A moderator finishes CAL_EXT and CAL_GND, then taps Submit for review. A request appears on your Approval page. You open Lakitu and Ring, then you tap Approve or Reject. This page is what you do, step by step.

You are the reviewer. Your job is to watch the calibration video, decide Approve or Reject, and tell the moderator what to fix when you send it back.
Pictures below are from the live Twilight console, the Lakitu app, and the Ring sign-in page. Button names match the screen. Read slowly. Do one step at a time.

On this page

  1. Words you will see
  2. The full path in one picture
  3. Part A · Reviewer page (what to look for)
  4. How a request reaches you

1 · Words you will see

Same word on the screen. Same meaning every night.

Word on screenSimple meaning
ApprovalThe page where you check calibration videos.
PendingNew request. Nobody opened it yet.
In reviewSomeone opened it. A reviewer is looking now.
ApprovedYou said yes. The moderator can record the other scenes.
Auto-approvedThe system said yes after a long wait. Same result as Approved.
RejectedYou sent it back. The moderator must fix the list, then resubmit.
Submit for reviewThe moderator button that sends the request to you.
Resubmit for reviewThe moderator button after a reject. Sends it to you again.
Lakitu sessionThe Amazon tool with the calibration video / GIF.
RingThe camera dashboard for that team’s house.
QA itemOne reason you send the work back. You must pick at least one.
Station 1 / Station 3Lights-on capture stations. Only these use this gate.
CAL_EXT / CAL_GNDThe two calibration videos that must be done first.

2 · The full path in one picture

WhoWhat they do
ModeratorRecords CAL_EXT and CAL_GND. Taps Submit for review. Pastes the Lakitu URL (Station 1).
TwilightSaves the request. Shows it on the Approval page. May show a blue banner: “new approval request(s)”.
ReviewerOpens Approval. Clicks the row. Status becomes In review.
ReviewerTaps ↗ Lakitu session and ◎ Ring. Watches the video. Checks the house cameras.
ReviewerTaps Approve — or taps Reject, picks QA items, then Send back to moderator.
ModeratorSees a popup. If approved: other scenes unlock. If sent back: fix the list, then Resubmit for review.

3 · Sign in

  1. Open Twilight Tracker.
  2. Type your Orbit login. Reviewer and Admin accounts on the passwordless list do not type a password.
  3. Click Sign In.

Sign-in screen. Type your Orbit login, then click Sign In.

A reviewer lands on the Approval page only. An admin can open Approval from the top tabs. The Approval work is the same.

4 · Reviewer page — what to look for

After sign-in, a reviewer sees this home. Look at these 6 things first.

  1. The yellow title: Project Twilight Live QA Console. That means you are on the reviewer page.
  2. The word REVIEWER above the title.
  3. Only one tab: Approval. (An admin also sees Overview, Moderator Hub, and the other tabs.)
  4. A number on the Approval tab (example: 2). That is how many requests still need a decision.
  5. The list on the left. Each row is one team’s calibration.
  6. The empty box on the right: Select a request to review. Click a row to fill this box.

Reviewer title. You should see Project Twilight Live QA Console.

Reviewer Approval home. One Approval tab, the request list, and the empty review box on the right.

If you do not see Approval, you signed in as the wrong role. Sign out. Sign in with the reviewer login.

5 · How you receive a request from a moderator

You do not get a special email for this. Twilight puts the request on your Approval list.

  1. The moderator taps Submit for review.
  2. A new row appears. Status = PENDING.
  3. If you are on another page, a blue bar may appear at the top:

Blue bar: “2 new approval requests · refresh to review”. Click Refresh.

  1. Click Refresh. Twilight opens Approval and shows the new rows.
  2. You can also click the Approval tab yourself. Look at the number on the tab.
The number on the Approval tab counts Pending + In review only. Approved and Rejected do not add to that number.

6 · Status colors — read the pill

Each row has a color pill on the right. Learn these 5.

PillWhat it meansWhat you do
PENDINGNew. Nobody opened it.Click the row. Start the review.
IN REVIEWThe row was opened. Someone is checking.Open it. Finish Approve or Reject.
APPROVEDA reviewer said yes.No more action. You can still open Lakitu / Ring to look.
REJECTEDSent back with a QA list.Wait for the moderator to fix and resubmit. Then it comes back as Pending.
AUTO-APPROVEDThe system said yes after a long wait (late afternoon, still waiting more than 15 minutes).Same as Approved. The moderator is unlocked.

The five status pills: In review, Pending, Approved, Rejected, Auto-approved.

Filters

  1. Today — only requests from today’s Pacific date. The number in the pill is the count.
  2. All — every request.
  3. Last 7 days — this week.
  4. Date range — pick From and To.

Filter bar: Today, All, Last 7 days, Date range.

7 · Open a request

  1. Click a PENDING row.
  2. The pill changes to IN REVIEW right away.
  3. The right box fills with the team, the time, two links, and two buttons.

After you click a Pending row: the right box opens. Status becomes In review.

Review box: ↗ Lakitu session, ◎ Ring, optional note, green Approve, red Reject.

Look at the top of the box: IN REVIEW · STATION 1 (or Station 3). Check the moderator name and the team. Then open Lakitu.

8 · Open Lakitu (the calibration video)

Lakitu is the Amazon tool that holds the session video / GIF. You need it to judge the calibration.

  1. In the review box, click ↗ Lakitu session.
  2. A new browser tab opens.
  3. If you are not signed in, you see Passwordless Sign In. Type your Amazon / work email. Click Send Code. Enter the code.

Lakitu sign-in. Type your email. Click Send Code.

  1. After sign-in, Lakitu opens the session. You should see the participant / session page.
  2. If you land on a list first: find tonight’s session. Use Search by Name or ID.
  3. Click the copy icon next to the ID if you need the session ID.
  4. Click View Participant to open the session.

Lakitu session list. Search, then click View Participant. Copy the ID if you need it.

Lakitu participant page. The address looks like lakitu.ring.amazon.dev/p/…

What to look for in Lakitu
• The calibration GIF / video is there and plays.
• The checker board is in the frame (CAL_EXT).
• Ground calibration is visible (CAL_GND).
• Camera angle matches the SOP.
• Recording is long enough (not a 2-second clip).
• Light / lux looks correct for lights-on.
If the Lakitu button is grey and does not open: the moderator did not paste a URL. Reject with Recording is not showing (check camera setting), or ask them in Teams to resubmit with the URL.

9 · Open Ring (the house cameras)

Ring is the live camera dashboard for that team. Use it to check the real house while you watch Lakitu.

  1. Go back to the Twilight tab.
  2. In the same review box, click ◎ Ring.
  3. A new tab opens. Sign in to Ring if asked.

Ring sign-in. Type the team Ring email. Click Continue.

  1. Type the email for that team’s Ring account (Nighttime Centific 1–5).
  2. Click Continue. Finish sign-in.
  3. You should see the house cameras for that team.
What to look for in Ring
• The correct house / team dashboard opened.
• Cameras match the station (Station 1 or Station 3).
• Motion Detection is OFF.
• Light in the room matches what you saw in Lakitu.
Keep both tabs open: Twilight + Lakitu + Ring. Decide in Twilight. Do not close Twilight.

10 · Approve

  1. Lakitu looks good. Ring looks good.
  2. Optional: type a short note in Additional message (optional). Most nights you leave this empty.
  3. Click the green Approve button.
  4. The pill turns APPROVED.

After Approve: the box shows Approved by your name. No more Approve / Reject buttons.

The moderator gets a popup: Review complete · Approved. The other scenes on that station unlock. You are done with this row.

11 · Reject — and the 5 reject types

Use Reject when the video is wrong. Do not Approve “to be nice.” The moderator cannot continue until this is fixed.

  1. Click the red Reject button first.
  2. A red box opens: Send back to moderator.
  3. Tick every problem you see. You must tick at least one.
  4. Optional: type extra words in Additional message (optional).
  5. The red button now says Send back to moderator. Click it.
  6. Or click Cancel if you opened Reject by mistake.

After you click Reject: pick at least one QA item, then Send back to moderator.

The 5 QA items (tick the matching ones)

Tick thisWhen to use it
Calibration Checker Board correction neededThe board is missing, cut off, blurry, or not held the SOP way.
Recording length is not meeting the minimumThe clip is too short. It does not meet the time on the station (example: ≥ 90s).
Camera angle not following the SOPThe camera is too high, too low, or pointed the wrong way.
Lux/Light setting issueToo dark, too bright, or the lights-on setup is wrong.
Recording is not showing (check camera setting)Lakitu has no video, a black screen, or the wrong session.

Example: two items ticked — Checker Board and Camera angle.

After send-back: Rejected by you, plus the “SEND BACK · FIX THESE” list the moderator will see.

If you click Send back to moderator with no box ticked, Twilight shows: Pick at least one QA item to send back. Tick a box, then click again.
The moderator sees the same list. Use short extra notes: “Board is not fully in frame. Re-record CAL_EXT.”

12 · Auto-approved

If a request stays Pending too long late in the day (after about 3:30 PM Pacific, and still waiting more than 15 minutes), Twilight can mark it AUTO-APPROVED.

Auto-approved row. Decided by Auto. Same unlock as a human Approve.

Treat Auto-approved like Approved. The moderator is already unlocked. You do not need to click Approve again.

13 · Part B · What the moderator sees

Read this so you know what your decision does on their phone / laptop.

A. Before they submit

On Station 1 or Station 3, other scenes stay locked. After CAL_EXT and CAL_GND are Uploaded, they see a yellow card and a Submit for review button.

Moderator Station 1. CAL_EXT and CAL_GND are Uploaded. Submit for review sits under them. Other scenes stay locked.

Yellow card: “Calibration video must be done first.” Button: Submit for review.

B. They paste the Lakitu URL (Station 1)

On Station 1, Submit opens this window. They must paste the Lakitu session URL that shows the calibration GIF.

Lakitu session URL window. Paste the URL, then Submit.

How they copy the URL in Lakitu (same demo Twilight shows them):

  1. Open Lakitu. Find the session they just recorded.
  2. Copy the full address from the browser bar. It should look like:
    https://lakitu.ring.amazon.dev/p/…?session=…
  3. Paste it into Twilight. Click Submit.

In Lakitu: find the session, then copy the URL from the address bar.

C. They can also open Lakitu and Ring from their session bar

Moderator bar: Open Lakitu and Open Ring next to Lakitu session.

Ring is also in their Menu → Quick Links:

Menu row: Ring — Open the Ring dashboard in a new tab.

D. After they submit — they wait

Popup: Submitted for review. They tap Got it.

Blue “Awaiting review…” — status is Pending on your list.

When you open the row, they see “Awaiting review · reviewer checking…”

E. If you reject

Popup: Review complete · Sent back. Same QA list you ticked. They tap Confirm.

Then the yellow card becomes Calibration sent back with Resubmit for review. Other scenes stay locked until you approve the new submit.

F. If you approve

Popup: Review complete · Approved. They tap Confirm. Other scenes unlock.

14 · Quick checklist (print this)

StepDone?
1. Sign in as reviewerI see Project Twilight Live QA Console and the Approval tab.
2. Find new workI clicked Refresh if the blue bar appeared. I see Pending rows.
3. Open the rowPill is now In review. Right box shows the team.
4. LakituI clicked ↗ Lakitu session. Video / GIF plays. Board and angle look right.
5. RingI clicked ◎ Ring. Correct house. Motion Detection OFF.
6a. Good videoI clicked Approve. Pill is Approved.
6b. Bad videoI clicked Reject. I ticked every QA item. I clicked Send back to moderator.
7. Next rowI go back to the list. I open the next Pending.
Still stuck? Ask the project manager in Teams. Do not guess Approve if Lakitu will not open.
